script: It's 11 PM. You say just one more game. Your team goes 0 and 5. Someone blames you for using a different ping. You say it again. One more game. Suddenly it's 3 AM. Your mom opens the door. You slam the laptop shut like a criminal. I was sleeping, you say, at full volume, wide awake. Five minutes later. One more game.
